# `rpad`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `str`, right-padded with `pad` to a length of `len`.
If `str` is longer than `len`, the return value is shortened to `len` characters.
If `pad` is not specified, `str` will be padded to the right with space characters if it is
a character string, and with zeros if it is a binary string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
rpad(str, len[, pad])
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |

| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- rpad, example 1
> SELECT rpad('hi', 5, '??');
hi???
```

```sql
-- rpad, example 2
> SELECT rpad('hi', 1, '??');
h
```

```sql
-- rpad, example 3
> SELECT rpad('hi', 5);
hi   
```

```sql
-- rpad, example 4
> SELECT hex(rpad(unhex('aabb'), 5));
AABB000000
```

```sql
-- rpad, example 5
> SELECT hex(rpad(unhex('aabb'), 5, unhex('1122')));
AABB112211
```
